title: Great service & professional driver
text: Viviana, our driver, was helpful and informative when responding to our questions.  She had a good knowledge of this route and offered helpful recommendations.   Most important she was a very professional and safety conscience driver even when she encountered periods of very heavy rain. Our experience was very good and we recommend this service a driver to others.
author: Barrie_R

title: Great ride
text: Very comfortable ride fit all our luggage very professional and friendly driver. Made a couple of stops
